paragraphs: In [Arakhin 28b](https://www.sefaria.org/Arakhin.28b.4): Rav Chiyya bar Ami spoke in the name of Cholfana; see also the entry Ulpana.[^1][^2]

notes.text: The linked passage spells out Rav Chiyya bar Ami and gives Cholfana as the source of the ruling.
[Heilprin’s Ulpana entry](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=263&lang=en) proposes reading Ulpana for Cholfana in Arakhin. Hyman directs readers to the separate Ulpana entry.
